title: Release day keeps saved names that contain the word Catalog
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a custom role from before this release, role A, whose name contains the word Catalog.
  • Have a part from before this release, part A, whose description contains the word Catalog.
  • Start on Roles & Permissions (Settings, then Roles & Permissions).
custom_steps:
1. Click the edit (pencil) button of role A.
  2. Click Cancel.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  6. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  7. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Role A's name reads exactly as it was saved before this release, including the word Catalog.

Step 2:

  • The page closes without saving.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 5:

  • Part A's description still reads as typed before this release, including the word Catalog.

Step 6:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 7:

  • Part A's Part Library entry shows the same description: saved data was not renamed, only the screen's own words changed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S12-N3: “No stored data is renamed. The story is confined to text a user reads on screen.”
  • Story 12, context note: “Context note: a catalog is something a shop buys from. This list is the shop's own record of the parts it knows, which is a library.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
